args: if [ -x myenv/bin/python ]; then exec myenv/bin/python -m trading_agent.mcp; else exec python -m trading_agent.mcp; fi
trading-agent.description: Trading-agent read-only surface (skill 48). Positions, journal, presets, scanner, quotes. Never places orders. Uses the repo's myenv virtualenv when present, so it starts without an activated venv (e.g. after a reboot).
